title: implement the simple MLP

atoms.evidence: self.flatten = Flatten(); self.linear1 = Linear(...); self.relu = ReLU(); self.linear2 = Linear(...) — child Modules assigned as attributes auto-register as sub-modules
self.relu = ReLU() used in pipeline self.linear2(self.relu(self.linear1(...))); the ReLU itself is just composed, not implemented here

atoms_in_seed_but_not_actually_present.reason: no nn.Parameter calls — all learnable weights live inside the imported Linear submodules; learner only composes Modules
the Flatten Module handles the (batch, 28, 28) -> (batch, 784) reshape; learner doesn't call .view/.reshape directly

notes: Pure composition exercise — 3 atoms, low for a Module exercise but appropriate because all the heavy lifting (parameters, init, the actual linear op) is delegated to imported sub-Modules. Validates module-composition as a distinct atom from nn-module-subclass + nn-parameter-wrap: you can subclass nn.Module without ever defining a Parameter if you delegate to children.
